resolved_conflicts.explanation: WillhiteWeb's text says September 1935; its captions and the Weebly listing say August 11, 1935. Not resolved; the story reports both.

notes_for_editor: Status 'gone' rests on the 1970 abandonment and the Weebly 'Removed' label; no source describes the structure's removal or what remains, so that part is inferred. The site now lies inside North Cascades National Park, and no access level is recorded because no source describes access. The NPS historic resource study appendix (npshistory.com) returned almost no text, so it was not used. The record's 6,542 ft (1,994 m) elevation matches firetower.org.
